audio-minute-base.eventDescription: One started minute of audio or video transcribed with the base Whisper model (a 30 min 20 s file is 31 minutes). Failed files are free.

audio-minute-small.eventDescription: One started minute of audio or video transcribed with the more accurate small Whisper model. Failed files are free.

published-transcript.eventDescription: One podcast episode returned from the transcript its publisher links in the feed (<podcast:transcript>), instead of Whisper. Charged instead of audio minutes, never both.
